title: Multiple Classes – LSC Related List – Add Class After Creation – Students from New Class Auto-Assigned to Lesson
description: BR-32/33 — CRUD Testing — Validates that adding a LSC record via the related list on an existing lesson auto-assigns all students from that class.
preconditions:
- SF org flag TRUE
- Lesson "Lesson MC-01" has 1 LSC for Class Alpha (3 students assigned)
- Class Beta has 3 enrolled active students not on the lesson
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Open Lesson Detail for "Lesson MC-01"
2. Navigate to "Lesson Schedule Class" related list
3. Click "New" to create a new LSC record
4. Select "Class Beta" and save
5. Wait up to 2 minutes for the auto-assignment batch to complete
6. Navigate to Student Session related list on "Lesson MC-01"
7. Count Student Sessions from Class Beta
steps_result:
1. Lesson Detail displayed; Class shows "Class Alpha"
2. LSC related list visible with 1 record (Class Alpha)
3. New LSC form opens
4. LSC saved; related list shows 2 records (Class Alpha and Class Beta)
5. Batch completes
6. Student Session list displayed
7. Exactly 3 new Student Sessions from Class Beta; total = 6

title: Multiple Classes – LSC Related List – Remove Class After Creation – Students Auto-Removed and LA Decremented
description: BR-32/33 — CRUD Testing — Validates that deleting an LSC record auto-removes students from that class and decrements their Lesson Allocation count.
preconditions:
- SF org flag TRUE
- Lesson "Lesson MC-01" has Class Alpha (3 students) and Class Beta (3 students); 6 sessions total
- Student B1 is in Class Beta only; LA Lesson Allocated = 1
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Open Lesson Detail for "Lesson MC-01"
2. Navigate to "Lesson Schedule Class" related list
3. Open the LSC record for "Class Beta"
4. Delete the LSC record for Class Beta
5. Wait up to 2 minutes for auto-removal batch to complete
6. Navigate to Student Session related list on "Lesson MC-01"
7. Count remaining sessions
8. Open Student B1's Lesson Allocation and read "Lesson Allocated" count
steps_result:
1. Lesson Detail displayed; Class shows "Class Alpha, Class Beta"
2. Related list shows 2 LSC records
3. LSC record for Class Beta opened
4. LSC for Class Beta deleted; related list shows only Class Alpha
5. Batch completes
6. Student Session list displayed
7. Only 3 sessions remain (Class Alpha students only)
8. Student B1's LA "Lesson Allocated" decremented by 1

title: Multiple Classes – LSC Related List – Add Class Then Remove – Student Sessions Updated After Each Operation
description: BR-32/33 — CRUD Testing — Validates the full lifecycle: add class → students assigned; remove class → students removed.
preconditions:
- SF org flag TRUE
- Lesson "Lesson MC-01" has 1 LSC for Class Alpha (3 students)
- Class Beta has 2 enrolled students not on the lesson
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Add LSC record for Class Beta on "Lesson MC-01" related list
2. Wait for auto-assign; open Student Session list
3. Delete the LSC record for Class Beta
4. Wait for auto-removal to complete
5. Open Student Session related list on "Lesson MC-01"
steps_result:
1. LSC for Class Beta created; related list shows 2 records
2. 5 sessions total (3 Class Alpha + 2 Class Beta); Class shows "Class Alpha, Class Beta"
3. Class Beta LSC deleted; related list shows 1 record
4. Batch completes
5. Only 3 sessions remain (Class Alpha only); Class shows "Class Alpha"

title: Multiple Classes – LSC Related List – Remove One Class – Student in Both Classes Remains Assigned via Remaining Class
description: BR-32/33 — CRUD Testing — Validates that removing one class does not remove a student who is also a member of the remaining class.
preconditions:
- SF org flag TRUE
- Lesson "Lesson MC-01" has Class Alpha and Class Beta
- Student X is a member of BOTH Class Alpha and Class Beta; has 1 Student Session (deduplicated)
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Open "Lesson Schedule Class" related list on "Lesson MC-01"
2. Delete the LSC record for "Class Beta"
3. Wait up to 2 minutes for auto-removal batch to complete
4. Navigate to Student Session related list on "Lesson MC-01"
5. Find Student X in the Student Session list
steps_result:
1. Related list shows 2 LSC records
2. Class Beta LSC deleted; only Class Alpha remains
3. Batch completes
4. Student Session list displayed
5. Student X still has an active session (not removed, because they remain in Class Alpha)

title: Multiple Classes – LSC Related List – Add Class via SF – BO Lesson Detail Shows Updated Class Names
description: BR-32 — CRUD Testing — Validates that after adding a class via SF LSC related list, the BO Lesson Detail reflects the updated comma-separated class list after sync.
preconditions: - SF flag TRUE + Unleash BO flag ON\n- Lesson "Lesson MC-01" has Class Alpha; BO shows "Class Alpha"\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to SF and BO
steps_actions:
1. On SF, open "Lesson Schedule Class" related list for "Lesson MC-01"
2. Add LSC record for "Class Beta" and save
3. Wait 1–2 minutes for SF-to-BO sync
4. Navigate to BO Lesson Detail for "Lesson MC-01"
5. Read the Class field value in BO
steps_result:
1. Related list shows 1 LSC record (Class Alpha)
2. LSC saved; SF Lesson Detail shows "Class Alpha, Class Beta"
3. Sync completes
4. BO Lesson Detail displayed
5. BO shows "Class Alpha, Class Beta"
